items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: from Michaelangelo's time right on to now

ctx.x: What happens when you're not a businessman? A musician is so busy creating, developing his talent, that we would probably be playing with bows and arrows if it hadn't been for the businessmen.

But the strength of the musician is something that no man understands -- underneath the whole structure of what we're talking about with the businessman, there's something that keeps the audience alive and always has, from Michaelangelo's time right on to now. There are people who are artistic and who survive, in spite of the businessman.
